title: Apple's Vision Pro, Siri Teams Set for Major Job Cuts
summary: The Apple Vision Pro may have broken new technical ground when it debuted two years ago, but after the first wave of early adopters, sales of the $3,499, 22-ounce headset haven't exactly reached blockbuster levels.
